title: Fix missing upload button for reels and pictures

requirements.text: Add a clearly visible upload button (or FAB) accessible from the main navigation or Feed page that navigates authenticated users to the Upload page (/upload route). The button must be present and tappable on both mobile and desktop layouts.

quotes: The uploads of reels and pictures don't work no button to upload

acceptanceCriteria: An upload button or icon is visible in the bottom navigation bar or as a floating action button on the Feed, Profile, and Discover pages.
Tapping/clicking the upload button navigates to the /upload route.
The button is only functional when the user is authenticated; unauthenticated users see the AuthGuard login prompt.
The button is present on both mobile (small screens) and desktop layouts.

requirements.text: Verify and fix the Upload page (/upload) so that users can successfully upload both video (reels) and image (picture) files. The file input must accept video and image MIME types, the submit/upload button must be visible and enabled when a file is selected, and the chunked upload flow must complete without errors.

quotes: The uploads of reels and pictures don't work no button to upload

acceptanceCriteria: The Upload page renders a file picker that accepts video/* and image/* MIME types.
A submit/upload button is visible on the Upload page and becomes enabled once a file, title, and category are provided.
Selecting a video file and submitting triggers the chunked upload progress indicator and completes successfully.
Selecting an image/photo file and submitting completes successfully.
On successful upload the user is navigated to the feed and the new post appears.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Preserve the existing chunked upload logic in the Upload page; only fix UI/routing issues.
nonGoals: Changing the backend upload or blob-storage API.
Redesigning the Upload page form fields or layout beyond fixing the broken button.
Adding new media types beyond video and images.
